body.en:
The phrase "marine grade" suggests a material that resists the sea, and the material does not exist. What exists is a set of stainless steels and other alloys that resist the sea under certain conditions, and stop resisting when the conditions change — when the water warms, when chloride concentrates in a gap, when the part sits under a washer with no oxygen, when it is coupled to a different metal.

That is why marine selection is different from ordinary corrosion selection. On land, a stainless grade is chosen for the atmosphere it will see. In the sea, the question is which mechanism will kill the part first: general corrosion, pitting, crevice corrosion, galvanic corrosion, or stress corrosion cracking. Each has a different answer, and a grade that survives one can fail at another.

The most common mistake is treating stainless as a maintenance-free choice. A stainless fastener in a marine joint is still a component in an electrochemical system: it needs the right alloy, the right surface condition, the right isolation from other metals, and it needs to be inspected. Choosing stainless is the start of the decision, not the end of it.

The second most common mistake is choosing by name rather than by service. A buyer asks for "316" because 316 is the marine grade in common speech, and a 316 fastener in a warm, chloride-rich, low-oxygen crevice can fail in a way that a different alloy would not. The grade has a range of service, and the range has edges.

For procurement, this produces an unusual requirement: the specification has to state the exposure, not just the alloy. Position on the structure, immersion or splash, water temperature, cleaning regime, and the metals it will touch — those are the inputs that decide which alloy is adequate, and they are the inputs a supplier cannot guess.
body.zh:
「海洋级」这个词听起来像是一种能抗住海水的材料，而这种材料并不存在。存在的是这样一组不锈钢和其他合金：在某些条件下抗得住海水，条件一变就不再抗——水变暖、氯离子在缝隙里浓缩、零件压在垫圈下面没有氧气、或者它和另一种金属接在一起。

所以海工选型和普通防腐选型不是一回事。陆地上，选一个不锈钢牌号，看的是它要面对的大气环境；海里，问题变成"哪一种机制会先把它弄死"：全面腐蚀、点蚀、缝隙腐蚀、电偶腐蚀，还是应力腐蚀开裂。每一种机制对应不同的答案，扛得住其中一种的牌号，可能栽在另一种上。

最常见的错误，是把不锈钢当成"免维护"的选择。海工接头里的一颗不锈钢紧固件，仍然是电化学系统里的一个零件：它需要对的合金、对的表面状态、与非同类金属的正确隔离，还需要有人去检查。选不锈钢是决定的开始，不是结束。

第二常见的错误，是按名字选、不是按工况选。买方说"要 316"，因为日常话里 316 就是那个"海洋级"；而一颗 316 螺栓，处在温暖、富氯、贫氧的缝隙里，会以一种别的合金不会有的方式失效。牌号有它的适用范围，范围有边界。

对采购来说，这带来一个不太寻常的要求：规格里必须写清暴露条件，而不能只写合金。构件上的位置、浸没还是飞溅、水温、清洗制度、以及它会接触哪些金属——这些才是决定用哪个牌号的输入，而这些输入供应商猜不出来。

body.en:
The stainless grades used in marine work fall into a small number of groups, and the groups differ in what they resist rather than in strength. The austenitic group — the A2 and A4 families of common speech — is the default: good general corrosion resistance, easy to form and to thread, available everywhere. Within it, the higher-alloy members resist chlorides better, and the difference between the members is the difference between a splash zone and an immersed surface.

The duplex group sits above the austenitics: higher strength, better chloride resistance, and better resistance to stress corrosion cracking. It is the group that deals with warm seawater and with high-load marine joints where an austenitic grade would need a larger section. Its cost is higher and its supply is narrower, which is why it is specified where the exposure justifies it rather than as a default.

Below the stainless groups are the coated carbon steels: hot-dip galvanised, thermally sprayed aluminium, or heavy paint systems. These are legitimate marine choices, and they are better than stainless in some positions — notably where the part is large, where the coating can be maintained, and where the alternative would be an expensive alloy in a low-consequence location.

Above them sit the nickel alloys and the copper alloys, used where the exposure is severe and the consequence is high: pump components, propeller shaft fastenings, seawater pipework. They are specified rarely and specifically, and they are not a general answer to "marine".

The practical rule is that a grade is chosen by mechanism, not by reputation. Ask which failure the position permits, then choose the group that survives it, then check that the group is available in the size and the delivery the project needs.
body.zh:
海工用的不锈钢牌号，可以归成几个不多的组，组与组的差别在"扛得住什么"，不在强度。奥氏体这一组——日常说的 A2、A4 家族——是默认选择：通用耐蚀好、好成型、好搓丝、到处都有。组内合金含量更高的成员抗氯离子更好，成员之间的差距，就是"飞溅区"和"浸没面"之间的差距。

双相这一组在奥氏体之上：强度更高、抗氯离子更好、抗应力腐蚀开裂也更好。它对付的是温暖海水和高载荷海工接头——在那种位置上，奥氏体牌号往往要放大截面才够。代价是贵、供应面窄，所以它被用在暴露条件确实需要的地方，而不是当默认件。

不锈钢组之下是带涂层的碳钢：热镀锌、热喷涂铝、或者厚浆涂层体系。这些在海工里是正当选择，在某些位置甚至优于不锈钢——尤其是零件大、涂层能维护、而用不锈钢等于在一个后果不重的位置上放贵合金。

再往上，是镍基合金和铜合金，用在外露极恶劣、后果极严重的地方：泵件、尾轴紧固、海水管路。它们被指名使用、用得很少，也不是"海洋"这个问题的通用答案。

能站住的规则是：按机制选牌号，不按名声选。先问这个位置允许哪一种失效，再选扛得住它的那一组，最后确认这一组在项目需要的尺寸和交期上供得到。

body.en:
Crevice corrosion is the marine failure that most often surprises buyers, because it happens to good stainless in a place nobody looks. The mechanism is simple: in a tight gap — under a washer, between a bolt head and a plate, under a deposit, in a threaded joint that is not fully sealed — the oxygen is consumed and cannot be replenished. The stainless relies on oxygen to maintain its passive layer, so the gap loses its protection and corrodes while the open surface next to it stays bright.

This is why the fasteners that fail in marine service are often the ones with the best-looking surface. The visible part is passive and intact; the failure is under the washer, in the thread, or under a clamp where water sits and air does not reach.

The design responses are known and cheap. Eliminate the gap where possible: use a joint that does not trap water, slope or drain it, and avoid overlapping surfaces. Seal the gap where it cannot be eliminated: a sealant or a gasket that keeps the chloride out. Use a grade with more resistance where the gap is unavoidable. And inspect the places where gaps exist, because that is where the failure will be.

Washers deserve a specific mention, because they create the classic crevice. A washer under a bolt head in a marine joint is a gap with a small oxygen supply; the answer is either a sealed washer arrangement or a material and coating choice that tolerates it. Choosing a bigger washer does not help; it makes a bigger crevice.

For the supplier, the practical consequence is that surface finish and passivation matter as much as alloy. A fastener with a rough, contaminated surface has more crevices built into it, and one that has been properly pickled and passivated starts with its passive layer intact rather than relying on the sea air to rebuild it.
body.zh:
缝隙腐蚀是海工里最让买方意外的失效，因为它发生在好不锈钢身上，而且发生在没人看的那个地方。机制很简单：在一个很紧的缝隙里——垫圈下面、螺栓头和板之间、沉积物下面、没有完全密封的螺纹接头里——氧气被消耗光，又补不进来。不锈钢靠氧气维持钝化膜，于是缝隙失去了保护、开始腐蚀，而它旁边敞开的表面还是亮的。

所以在海工里失效的紧固件，经常是表面最漂亮的那一批。看得见的部分钝化完好，失效在垫圈下面、在螺纹里、在卡箍底下——那里有水，但没有空气。

设计上的应对办法其实都便宜：能消掉的缝隙就消掉（用不积水的接头、做出排水坡度、避免贴合面重叠）；消不掉的缝就封住（密封胶或垫片，把氯离子挡在外面）；缝隙不可避免，就选一个抗性更高的牌号；最后，缝隙存在的地方要安排检查，因为失效一定在那里。

垫圈要单独说一句，因为它制造的正是那个典型缝隙。海工接头里螺栓头下面的一片垫圈，就是一个氧气补给很少的缝隙；答案要么是把垫圈做成密封结构，要么是选能容忍它的材料与涂层。换更大的垫圈不解决问题——它只是把缝隙做大。

对供应商来说，实际后果是表面处理与合金同等重要。表面粗糙、带污染的螺栓，本身就把更多缝隙做进去了；而经过正规酸洗与钝化的螺栓，是带着完好的钝化膜进入服役的，不靠海风慢慢给它重建。

body.en:
A marine structure is a set of different metals in contact through salt water, which is an electrolyte. Every junction between two metals is a galvanic cell, and the less noble metal in the pair corrodes faster than it would alone. The pairings that matter in fastener work are predictable: stainless against aluminium, stainless against galvanised steel, stainless against bronze or copper alloy, and carbon steel against anything.

Stainless against aluminium is the pairing that fails most visibly in boat and coastal work: the aluminium becomes the anode and corrodes around the fastener, sometimes to the point of losing the fixing. The practical answers are isolation (a barrier between the metals), a coating system that keeps the electrolyte off the junction, or a change of one of the materials.

Stainless against galvanised steel is subtler. In dry conditions the pair is quiet; in wet conditions the zinc becomes the anode and is consumed, and the galvanised surface around the stainless fastener thins. The result is a joint that looks fine and a plate that has lost its protection in a ring around each bolt.

The area ratio matters as much as the metal pair. A small anode against a large cathode corrodes quickly, because the current density at the anode is high. That is why a small stainless fastener in a large aluminium plate is a worse case than the reverse, and why the recommendation is usually to isolate rather than to hope.

Isolation is not exotic: a nylon or PTFE washer, a isolating sleeve, a coated interface, or a sealant at the joint. The cost is small and the effect is large, and the omission is usually invisible until the structure is opened up for inspection.
body.zh:
一个海工结构，是一堆不同金属通过盐水接触在一起，而盐水是电解质。任意两种金属的接缝都是一个电偶电池，其中电位较低的那种腐蚀得比它单独存在时更快。紧固件上真正要紧的配对是可数的：不锈钢对铝、不锈钢对镀锌钢、不锈钢对青铜或铜合金，以及碳钢对任何东西。

不锈钢对铝，是船艇和沿海工程里失效最显眼的一对：铝变成阳极，在紧固件周围腐蚀，有时候连固定都保不住。实际答案有三个——隔离（两种金属之间加一层屏障）、用涂层体系把电解质挡在接缝之外、或者换掉其中一种材料。

不锈钢对镀锌钢更隐蔽。干燥时这一对很安静；潮湿时锌变成阳极被消耗，不锈钢螺栓周围那圈镀锌层就薄下去。结果是：接头看上去没事，而板子每颗螺栓周围都失去了一圈保护。

面积比和金属配对同样要紧。小阳极对大阴极腐蚀得快，因为阳极上的电流密度高。所以"一颗小不锈钢螺栓装在一大片铝板里"，比反过来糟糕得多，也是为什么建议通常是隔离，而不是赌它没事。

隔离并不稀奇：尼龙或聚四氟垫圈、绝缘套管、带涂层的接触面、接缝处打胶。成本很小、效果很大，而漏掉这一步通常看不出来，直到结构打开做检查。

body.en:
A stainless fastener's corrosion resistance is not in the alloy alone; it is in the passive layer on the surface, and that layer has to exist before the part goes into service. Pickling removes the contamination and the heat tint from manufacture; passivation rebuilds the oxide layer afterwards. A part that has been machined, welded or threaded and then shipped without either starts its marine life with a surface that is chemically uneven.

This matters most at the places manufacture leaves behind: the thread roots, the transition between head and shank, the cut end of a stud, and any weld. Those are the sites where contamination and heat tint sit, and they are the sites where pitting starts.

The buyer's check is therefore partly a surface check. A properly treated part has a uniform, clean, slightly dull surface without heat tint, without embedded iron, and without the discolouration that comes from grinding with the wrong wheel. A test with a copper sulphate solution or a ferroxyl test can indicate free iron on the surface, and a simple water-break test shows whether the surface is clean enough to be passivated.

Contamination also arrives in transit. A stainless fastener handled with gloves that touched carbon steel, packed in a carton with a rusty staple, or stored in a steel bin will pick up free iron and pit in service. The packing requirement is therefore part of the corrosion requirement, not a logistics detail.

What a buyer should ask for is not "passivated" but a defined treatment: pickled and passivated to a named practice, with the surface condition checked before packing, and with packing that does not reintroduce the contamination the treatment removed.
body.zh:
不锈钢的耐蚀性不只在合金里，还在表面那层钝化膜里，而这层膜必须在零件进入服役之前就已经存在。酸洗去掉制造留下的污染和热氧化色，钝化在之后重建氧化层。一个经过机加工、焊接或搓丝，然后既不酸洗也不钝化就发货的零件，是带着化学上不均匀的表面开始它的海工生涯的。

这件事在制造留下的那些位置上最要紧：螺纹根部、头与杆的过渡、双头螺柱的切断端，以及任何焊缝。污染和热氧化色就停在那里，点蚀也从那里开始。

所以买方的检查里，有一部分是表面检查。处理到位的零件表面均匀、干净、略微发暗，没有热氧化色、没有嵌入的铁、也没有用错砂轮打磨留下的变色。硫酸铜试验或铁氰化钾试验可以看出表面有没有游离铁，简单的水膜连续性试验（water-break）能看出表面是否干净到可以钝化。

污染也会在运输途中回来。用手套碰过碳钢的手去搬不锈钢、装箱时混进一枚生锈的订书钉、或者存放在钢制料箱里，都会让零件沾上游离铁，然后在服役中点蚀。所以包装要求本身就是防腐要求的一部分，不是物流细节。

买方该要的不是一句「已钝化」，而是一道明确的处理：按指定工艺酸洗并钝化、装箱前检查表面状态、包装不会再引入被处理掉的污染。

body.en:
Marine and coastal buyers ask a small set of questions, and the answers are usually about service conditions rather than about grades.

The most common is whether 316 is enough. It is enough for many atmospheric and splash-zone positions and it is not enough for warm, chloride-rich, low-oxygen positions, and the difference is decided by the position rather than by the project's general description. The second is whether stainless can be used against aluminium; it can, with isolation, and without isolation the aluminium will pay for it.

The third is how to tell a properly passivated part from a bright one. The answer is the surface condition and the test, not the appearance: a bright part may be contaminated and a dull part may be correct. The fourth is what coating to use on the carbon steel parts of the same structure; the answer is a system chosen for the exposure and maintained, because a coating that is not maintained becomes a crevice rather than a barrier.

See frequently asked questions below.

Related resources: high-tensile bolts anchor bolts stainless steel fasteners hex bolts
body.zh:
海洋和沿海项目的买方就问那么几条，答案多半落在工况上，而不是在牌号上。

最常见的是 316 够不够。对很多大气和飞溅区位置够，对温暖、富氯、贫氧的位置不够——而这个差别由位置决定，不由项目的总体描述决定。第二个是不锈钢能不能装在铝件上：能，但要隔离；不隔离，付代价的是铝。

第三个是怎么分辨「钝化到位」和「表面很亮」。答案是看表面状态和试验，不看外观：亮的可能带污染，发暗的可能是对的。第四个是同一结构上的碳钢件该做什么涂层——答案是为暴露条件选一套体系并且维护它，因为不维护的涂层会从屏障变成一个缝隙。
